headlines.title: Outages reported at the NSA and Apple
headlines.description: A classified computer network used by the National Security Agency went down due to a technical problem. It comes as Apple was experiencing a tech issue that was affecting a several of its consumer-facing services. Mitch Ashley, VP of the Futurum Group, discusses how concerned we should be after several outages were reported across banking, aviation and tech.

headlines.title: A Kremlin trap? Europe sees danger in Vladimir Putin’s new demand in U.S. talks
headlines.description: European leaders have long feared being frozen out of U.S.-Russia peace talks about Ukraine. Now Trump’s team negotiating the continent’s security structure.

headlines.title: Trump Arrives in Asia for Historic Meeting With Xi Jinping and Putin
headlines.description: President Donald Trump touched down in the Philippines on Tuesday for a summit with Southeast Asian nations ahead of his meeting with his counterparts from Russia and China on Thursday. It comes as the president is now suggesting his three-day trip might also include a conversation with North Korean leader Kim Jong Un. NBC’s Garrett Haake reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: New Concerns Arise Over What AI Toys Could Be Teaching Kids
headlines.description: With more AI-enabled toys being sold in stores and online, a new report is showing how some toys marketed for learning can be full of mistakes, while others might even share graphic or explicit details not suitable for children. NBC’s Savannah Sellers reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: Highlights from Pope Leo’s historic, 12-day tour of South America
headlines.description: They turned out in their millions to greet Pope Leo as he made his way around Uruguay, Argentina and Peru on a gruelling 12-day tour of the South America.

headlines.title: 2026 Rockefeller Center Christmas Tree Arrives in New York City
headlines.description: A magnificent Norway spruce has made its journey from West Edmeston, New York, to Rockefeller Center. The tree will undergo a glow-up ahead of the lighting ceremony on Dec. 2.

headlines.title: Democrats with 2028 ambitions say their party still must prove itself to win the White House: From the Politics Desk
headlines.description: In today’s edition, Natasha Korecki files a dispatch from a recent gathering of jubilant, but forward-looking, Democrats in Denver.

headlines.title: Gas geyser and noxious odor from L.A. area landfill prompts public health response
headlines.description: Pungent odors wafting from the Chiquita Canyon Landfill prompted Los Angeles County officials to relocate residents after drilling unleashed a geyser of trash and fumes.

headlines.title: Apple reports outages after internal update, says it is working to get systems back online
headlines.description: Apple said it was experiencing tech issues Tuesday that were affecting several of its popular consumer-facing services.

headlines.title: Ray Tintori, filmmaker and boyfriend of ‘SNL’ alum Heidi Gardner, dies at 43
headlines.description: Filmmaker Ray Tintori, the boyfriend of former “Saturday Night Live” cast member Heidi Gardner, has died, the New York City medical examiner’s office confirmed Tuesday.

headlines.title: Classified NSA network went down, but no indication it was an attack, sources say
headlines.description: A classified computer network used by the National Security Agency went down due to a technical problem Tuesday, but there was no indication that it was an attack, sources say
